p: they stand by: That is, they who are mentioned, Ne 7:2.
children of the province: That is, the inhabitants of Judah.
Azariah: Azariah in Ezra is called Seraiah, and Raamiah Reelaiah Ezr 2:2.
children of Gibeon: That is, the inhabitants of Gibeon.
of the other Nebo: For there were two cities with this name.
the Tirshatha said unto them: Meaning, Nehemiah: for Tirshatha in the Chaldee tongue means a butler.
seventh month came: Which contained part of September and part of October.
